title: Shim Builder
description: Create, inspect, and extract shim programs
description_cn: 创建、检查和提取 shim 程序

output.title: Output Path
output.description: Output path for the shim program

mode.title: Runtime Mode
mode.description: Runtime mode: external (stub+config), bundle (single-file), hybrid (embedded config + external target)
mode.description_cn: 运行模式：external（桩+配置文件）、bundle（单文件）、hybrid（嵌入配置+外部目标）

entry.title: Target Entry
entry.description: Target executable path (required for all modes)
entry.description_cn: 目标可执行文件路径（所有模式都需要）

runner.title: Entry Runner
runner.description: How the target entry is launched

args.title: Target Arguments
args.description: Arguments to pass to the target (repeatable)
args.description_cn: 传递给目标的参数（可重复）

overrideArgs.title: Override Args
overrideArgs.description: Only use config arguments; ignore user-supplied arguments at runtime
overrideArgs.description_cn: 仅使用配置参数，运行时忽略用户输入参数

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description_cn: 环境变量，KEY=VALUE 格式（可重复）

overrideEnv.title: Override Env
overrideEnv.description: Only use config environment variables; ignore inherited environment
overrideEnv.description_cn: 仅使用配置环境变量，忽略继承的环境

payload.title: Payload Directory
payload.description: Payload directory to embed (bundle mode only); auto-archived as zip/tar.gz
payload.description_cn: 要嵌入的负载目录（仅 bundle 模式）；自动打包为 zip/tar.gz

extractPolicy.title: Extraction Policy
extractPolicy.description: Where to extract bundled payload at runtime
extractPolicy.description_cn: 运行时提取捆绑负载的位置

extractPath.title: Custom Extract Path
extractPath.description: Custom extraction path (only used when extract-policy is 'custom')
extractPath.description_cn: 自定义提取路径（仅 extract-policy 为 'custom' 时使用）

cleanup.title: Cleanup on Exit
cleanup.description: Clean up extracted files on exit
cleanup.description_cn: 退出时清理提取的文件

elevate.title: UAC Elevation
elevate.description_cn: 请求管理员权限（仅 Windows）

configFile.title: Config File
configFile.description: Load base config from JSON file (CLI options override)
configFile.description_cn: 从 JSON 文件加载基础配置（CLI 选项会覆盖）

bundlePath.title: Bundle Path
bundlePath.description: Path to the shim program to inspect
bundlePath.description_cn: 要检查的 shim 程序路径

json.title: JSON Output
json.description_cn: 以机器可读的 JSON 格式输出

bundlePath.title: Bundle Path
bundlePath.description: Path to the shim program to extract
bundlePath.description_cn: 要提取的 shim 程序路径

outputDir.title: Output Directory
outputDir.description_cn: 提取文件的输出目录（默认：<bundle-name>-extracted/）
